primary: 256 KiB offered on each of 16 established streams; full verified throughput and owner CPU/GiB.
method: Independent randomized paired 24-block holdout with 12 AB and 12 BA per cell. Unmodified stock C and ordinary 256 KiB cap, flat owner, 128 events per callback, identical optimization flags. The candidate moves inline scratch to offset zero, allocates a single host-page-aligned relay object with posix_memalign, explicitly zeros it, and uses stock free/release. Equal requested object sizes. No data-path or buffer pointer substitution. Wall throughput includes all byte generation/delivery and verification within the wave loop on a background thread. Owner CPU times native drains. Priming and teardown are excluded. Marked binaries separately time one reply from injection just after the first bulk write until its forwarded write on the owner; each cell checks exact bulk bytes ahead of every reply, both FINs and reverse data. These are anonymous socketpairs, not TCP latency or an end-to-end peer result. Intervals resample paired per-block changes, including paired within-block p95/p99.
